anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly higher than the number of available cores, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, adjustments, or opportunities generated, indicating potential inactivity or malfunction.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially enhance AI strategy algorithms to ensure they are functioning and generating opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the cause of overutilization.
recommendations.rationale: Sustained high CPU load can lead to system instability, degraded performance, and potential downtime, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform diagnostics on the AI module to determine why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness, impacting profitability.

recommendations.action: Monitor memory usage trends to ensure they remain within acceptable limits and optimize if necessary.
recommendations.rationale: While current memory usage is within limits, proactive monitoring can prevent future issues as the system load changes.
